scientific_integrity: Four-part symbolic proof for arbitrary m>=3; finite exact dynamic-programming checks are corroboration only. Historical priority is qualified by possible unindexed equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the additive-ideal product of O_2 and O_m for all m>=3; the known m=2 geometric-sequence case is only a boundary check. It does not address general semigroup products, individual elementwise product sets, or ideal powers. Prior literature is not exhaustively indexed; independent audit has not occurred.
title: Parity-normal forms for mixed products of ordinary numerical semigroups
